# PureTTS

> PureTTS is a 100% free, private, unlimited AI Text-to-Speech (TTS) studio and PDF audio reader that runs entirely inside the user's web browser using WebGPU and WebAssembly. Powered by the open-weight Kokoro-82M v1.0 neural model (Apache 2.0), it supports **33 studio voices across 10 languages**, requires no account, no login, no subscriptions, and enforces zero character limits.

PureTTS executes all multilingual International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) tokenization, ONNX Runtime Web neural inference (`wasm-q4` Turbo Mode ~45 MB, `wasm-q8` Fast Mode ~85 MB, and `fp32` WebGPU Studio Mode ~326 MB reaching up to 10.9× real-time speed), and uncompressed 24,000 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV synthesis inside an isolated browser Web Worker on the user's local device. Zero text, PDF, or audio data is ever uploaded to any external server.

## Supported Languages & Regional Voices (33 Neural Voices)

- **American English (`en-US`)**: `af_heart`, `af_bella`, `af_sky`, `af_sarah`, `am_adam`, `am_michael`
- **British English (`en-GB`)**: `bf_emma`, `bf_isabella`, `bm_george`, `bm_lewis`
- **European Portuguese (`pt-PT` — Portugal)**: `pt_dora`, `pt_alex`, `pt_santa` (Lisbon/Coimbra vowel reduction & sibilant sandhi)
- **Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR` — Brasil)**: `ptbr_dora`, `ptbr_alex`, `ptbr_santa` (Dental stop palatalization & coda L-vocalization)
- **Castilian Spanish (`es-ES` — Spain)**: `es_dora`, `es_alex`, `es_santa` (Peninsular distinción `/θ/`)
- **Latin American Spanish (`es-419`)**: `esla_dora`, `esla_alex`, `esla_santa` (Neutral seseo `/s/`)
- **French (`fr-FR`)**: `ff_siwis`
- **Italian (`it-IT`)**: `if_sara`, `im_nicola`
- **Hindi (`hi-IN` — Devanagari & Romanized)**: `hf_alpha`, `hf_beta`, `hm_omega`, `hm_psi`
- **Japanese (`ja-JP`)**: `jf_alpha`, `jf_gongitsune`, `jf_nezumi`, `jf_tebukuro`, `jm_kumo`
- **Mandarin Chinese (`zh-CN` — Putonghua)**: `zf_xiaobei`, `zf_xiaoni`, `zf_xiaoxiao`, `zf_xiaoyi`, `zm_yunjian`, `zm_yunxi`, `zm_yunxia`, `zm_yunyang`

## Core Tools & Applications

- [PureTTS Studio (Homepage)](https://puretts.com/): Free unlimited in-browser AI text-to-speech converter with 33 studio voices across 10 languages, Turbo Mode (`wasm-q4` ~45 MB) & WebGPU Studio (`fp32`), asymmetric first-chunk micro-chunking for instant streaming playback, speaking speed control (`0.5x` to `2.0x`), and lossless 24kHz WAV export.
- [Free PDF to Speech Converter](https://puretts.com/pdf-to-speech.html): Client-side multi-page PDF audio reader powered by Mozilla PDF.js and Kokoro-82M with page-range extraction and automatic hyphenation/line-break cleanup.
- [Free ElevenLabs Alternative](https://puretts.com/elevenlabs-alternative.html): Side-by-side architectural and empirical latency benchmark (WebGPU vs. WASM vs. Cloud TTS) and unlimited voiceover studio for YouTube creators, audiobook narrators, and indie game developers.
- [Free Speechify Alternative](https://puretts.com/speechify-alternative.html): 100% free, unlimited alternative to Speechify's $139/year paywall for students, ADHD & dyslexia readers, and multilingual academic researchers.
- [Free YouTube & Shorts AI Voiceover Generator](https://puretts.com/youtube-voiceover-generator.html): Commercial-ready (Apache 2.0) 24kHz 16-bit WAV voiceover studio and 10-language channel localization guide for YouTube channels, documentaries, TikToks, and Instagram Reels.

## Documentation & Technical Guides

- [AI Voice Directing, Prosody & WAV Mastering Guide](https://puretts.com/guides.html): Production handbook covering punctuation prosody engineering, vocal timbre profiles for all 33 Kokoro-82M voices across 10 languages, multilingual script formatting, and -14 LUFS / ACX audio mastering.
- [How Client-Side WebGPU & WebAssembly Neural TTS Works](https://puretts.com/architecture.html): Engineering deep dive into the 4-stage browser synthesis pipeline, StyleTTS2/ISTFTNet architecture, empirical M5 Pro benchmarks (TTFA, RTF, chars/sec across `fp32`, `wasm-q4`, and `wasm-q8`), and client-side multilingual IPA G2P engines.
- [About PureTTS & Open-Source Mission](https://puretts.com/about.html): Overview of PureTTS's accessibility mission, 2026 engineering release changelog, Apache 2.0 commercial licensing rights, and open-source technology stack.
